This case-sensitive code system https://ig.santeon.nl/careplan/CodeSystem/deidentification-action-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
none NoneExport the element unchanged. Requires an exceptionReason.
hash HashReplace the value with an HMAC hash.
shift ShiftMove a date/dateTime by a per-patient offset.
clamp-age Clamp ageBound the age implied by a birth date to a range.
first-of-month First of monthFloor a date to the first day of its month.
